name: Icon Duo Themes
description: Colour pairings for Lolly Demo's two-colour Etiquette icons, from the Opal palette: c1 = accent, c2 = base. Green leads, so 'brand' (Green Apple on Spearmint) is the default pairing and the fills every icon file carries. previewBg is the surface a light pairing needs behind it to stay visible in pickers and previews.
